descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Kuwait City puts you in the captain's seat over the real Kuwait.

THE REAL KUWAIT CITY
The Kuwait Towers on their point, Al Hamra, the NBK and Arraya towers, the Liberation Tower, the Grand Mosque, Seif Palace, the National Assembly, Souq Al-Mubarakiya and the Sheikh Jaber Al-Ahmad Cultural Centre.

KUWAIT BAY AND THE GULF
Fly low along the 36 km Sheikh Jaber Causeway to Subiya, past ships at anchor and dhows off Souq Sharq, then down the coast past Green Island, Marina Mall, the Scientific Center, Messila and Fintas to Ahmadi and Fahaheel.

A LIVING CITY
Traffic on the real roads, yachts, dhows and tankers on the water. At night the towers, the Corniche and the causeway light up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances and your landing clearance.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar in Shuwaikh, the skyline out of the doors. Repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with cabins, a midsize jet and a fighter.

ELEVEN MISSIONS
City approach, Ali Al Salem approach, a sunset hop, the Causeway Run, between Al Hamra and the NBK tower, the Gulf coast, a fighter scramble, a city tour, Kuwait City by night.

ENGLISH AND ARABIC
Switch the menus in Settings.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
